Revert a specific evaluation history entry and recalculate recommendation state.

Supports:
- NOT_LIKED and NOT_LIKED_UNDO actions: Recalculates recommendation's is_liked state
- COMPLETED (intro request): Removes intro request and resets submission_candidate fields
- FACILITATED (intro facilitated): Removes facilitated status
- INTRODUCTION_NOT_FACILITATED (intro unavailable): Removes unavailable status

For pipeline intro requests (with recommendation_uuid):
- Only ONE intro request (COMPLETED) is allowed per recommendation
- Lifecycle: COMPLETED -> FACILITATED or INTRODUCTION_NOT_FACILITATED (one cycle)
- Resets submission_candidate fields only if all intro-related entries are removed

For global intro requests (without recommendation_uuid):
- Multiple cycles are allowed: COMPLETED -> FACILITATED -> COMPLETED (new cycle) -> ...
- Only one pending (COMPLETED) request at a time
- Only deletes evaluation_history and candidate_activity_log entries (no field resets)

Deletes all associated candidate_activity_log entries.

    This is an optional, but unique identifier for a company

    Private, public, non-profit, this can be None if unknown
hq_location : LocationAddress
    address where company headquarters resides

    top level sector this company belongs to.  The Yahoo API uses the
    morning star representation, the internal representation here is ICB
    as it is a more widely adopted standard and more intuitive.

    approximate number of employees at this company
stock_symbol : str
    stock ticker if this stock is publicly traded
morningstar_industry : str
    this is used for convenience as input from Yahoo Finance only, it will
    always be returned as None by Contender.  As an input, it will be translated
    to an ICB sector as that is the internal specification used

    if applicable, the annual revenue earned by this company
